title: Vintage Kitchen Still Life
description: A colorful retro kitchen corner with sage green distressed cabinets, a bright yellow and dark green refrigerator covered in magnets, and a black farmhouse sink under a vibrant stained glass window. Steam rises from a red pot on the counter beside a coffee maker, lavender, and various jars, with a rainbow light beam crossing the marble countertops.
